title: [PS4, PS5] Destiny – The Collection $2.99 (90% off) @ PlayStation Store
body:
Deal: [PS4, PS5] Destiny – The Collection $2.99 (90% off) @ PlayStation Store

[Twisty] Does it have a single player campaign and does it require PS Plus?
Any chance this game gets scraped and end up like Anthem unplayable or will it be patched so you can play when the servers go down
[Rebsphere] Yes, you need a PlayStation Plus subscription to play the core multiplayer activities in Destiny, but you do not need it for solo content.
[andigaming] Was hoping it would go on sale soon, $2.99 for the nostalgia even without multiplayer (don't have PS Plus) worth it.
